infra.confirm_vector: After changing the database, {n} existing checklists can't find their documents (they stay in the old database) and must be uploaded again. Continue?
infra.panel_desc: Set once during installation. A wrong value stops the system, so press “Edit” before changing anything.
infra.pg_hint: e.g. postgresql://user:password@host:5432/postgres — stored encrypted like the other keys
infra.vector_hint.local: Qdrant on this machine or your network. This app opens a secure connection to central itself, so nothing has to be exposed to the internet.
infra.vector_hint.pgvector: PostgreSQL with pgvector, e.g. Supabase, Neon or your own server
infra.vector_hint.pinecone: Pinecone (serverless) — the index is created for you
infra.vector_sub: Database that stores the documents for search
infra.warn_central: A wrong value stops uploads and checking right away. Usually set once at installation or when you get a new license.
infra.warn_vector: This stores the documents of every checklist. A wrong value makes them unsearchable right away. Change it only when moving the database.
job.delete_confirm: Delete “{name}” together with all its documents and results?
job.embedding_missing: The embedding model of this checklist was removed from the model library, so new documents can't be read. Create a new checklist.
jobform.name: Checklist name
jobform.title: New checklist
jobs.empty_body: Create a checklist, add its requirements, then upload documents to check.
jobs.setup_needed: Set up an AI connection and models in Settings before creating a checklist.
jobs.subtitle: Each checklist has its own requirements and documents. Upload the documents, then let the system check them against the requirements.
jobs.title: Checklists
kind.embedding.label: Embedding
kind.embedding.what: Reads documents so they can be searched. A checklist keeps the model it was created with.
kind.embedding.where: Chosen when a checklist is created
kind.llm.label: LLM
kind.llm.what: Turns pasted text into a requirement checklist.
kind.rerank.label: Rerank
kind.rerank.what: Scores each requirement against the documents more precisely. Optional, recommended. Needs a provider with a /rerank endpoint.
license.claim: Use the license on this machine
license.claim_confirm: Use the license on this machine? The other installation will be disconnected right away.
license.displaced_body: This machine has stopped connecting. One license works on one installation at a time, so another 1n9 program (or another computer) using the same key took it over.
license.displaced_title: This license was most recently activated on another machine
login.forgot: Forgot the password? Reset it on the machine that runs this app.
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue
login.title: Sign in
match.disclaimer: AI-assisted check. Always review the documents yourself before deciding.
match.need: Add at least one requirement and one document to check.
match.no_evidence: Nothing relevant was found in this document.
match.scorer_cosine: Scored by text similarity. Add a rerank model in Settings for a more precise check.
match.stale: Requirements or documents changed after the last check. Check again to update.
match.title: Check results
match.verdict_fail: {n} mandatory items not met or unclear
mode.compare_desc: Rank the documents against each other. Only items marked mandatory can fail a document.
mode.compliance_desc: Every required item is mandatory. Each document either passes or fails.
mode.label: How should documents be judged?
model.dim_hint: Press Test and the correct value is filled in
model.found_list: {n} models found — pick from the list or type one
model.locked_reason: {n} checklists use it — delete them first
model.no_connection: No usable connection yet — add one in Step 1 first.
model.params_hint: Sent to the provider as-is and works with any model. See your provider's docs for names. Add "headers" or "query" for extra HTTP headers or query parameters.
model.params_locked: Used by checklists — can't change (some parameters change the vectors)
model.test_dim: Working — this model gives {dim} dimensions (filled in)
model.thinking_used: used {n} thinking tokens (more time and cost)
model.used_default: Used wherever no specific model is chosen
models.panel_desc: Pick models from your connections. The one marked “Default” is what checklists use.
plan.activated: Activated — keep using the same license, nothing to reconfigure.
plan.cancelled: Checkout cancelled — you were not charged.
plan.card_failed: — the card payment failed, please update your card
plan.demo_hint: Subscribe and keep using the same license. Your data and settings stay as they are.
plan.no_prices: Prices are not set up yet — contact your provider.
plan.renew_hint: Renew by subscribing. Billed automatically every period; cancel anytime.
plan.slow: Payment received but the license hasn't updated yet. Wait a moment and refresh.
plan.title: Plan
req.empty: No requirements yet. Paste the text above or add them one by one.
req.extract_done: Added {n} requirements. Review them, then save.
req.extract_format: Read the list format directly (no AI used).
req.hard_hint: Documents without this are ranked last
req.load_confirm: Replace the current requirements with this template?
req.paste_label: Paste the text that lists the criteria, or a requirements list
req.subtitle: What the checklist requires. Required items count most; a mandatory item puts documents without it at the bottom.
req.subtitle_compliance: What the documents must satisfy. Every “required” item is mandatory; optional items are shown for information and never fail a document.
req.title: Requirements
res.drop: Drop the documents to check here or click to choose
res.drop_hint: You can select many files at once
res.subtitle: PDF, Word, text or Markdown, up to {mb} MB each. Scanned PDFs are read with OCR.
res.title: Documents
settings.license_desc: License status for this installation and your subscription.
settings.subtitle: AI connections, models and the services this system uses. Checklists use the default models.
settings.title: Settings
setup.ai.base_url_hint: Leave empty if your provider only needs an API key
setup.ai.desc: Use your own keys. You pay the AI provider you choose directly; we add nothing on top.
setup.ai.discover_first: Enter the LLM's API key above first; the models will be listed for you
setup.ai.emb_desc: Used to search documents. It is locked to a checklist when you create it; changing it later means creating a new checklist.
setup.ai.emb_title: Embedding — the model that turns text into vectors
setup.ai.llm_desc: Enter the API URL (if any) and API key, then choose a model
setup.ai.no_embedding_here: No embedding models on this connection — untick the box below and use another one, or type a name
setup.ai.none_found: The provider didn't return a model list — type the model name instead
setup.ai.privacy_note: Note: some providers' free keys may use your data to improve their services and are usually rate-limited per minute. Use a paid key for sensitive data or large files.
setup.ai.rerank_toggle: Add a reranker (optional) — orders search results more precisely
setup.ai.same_as_llm: Use the same API URL and key as the LLM
setup.ai.title: Connect AI
setup.ai.where_note: Enter the URL (if any) and API key, and the models are fetched from the provider for you to choose. You'll find these in the console of the AI provider you choose.
setup.finish.desc: Next: create a checklist, add its requirements, upload the documents and check them.
setup.finish.title: You're ready
setup.license.beta_desc: Free during the beta, no card needed. It won't be free forever: we'll announce the end at least 10 days ahead, and your license keeps working until the end of that month.
setup.license.email_hint: One free license per machine and email.
setup.license.key_hint: You get it after subscribing. Move between machines with the same key.
setup.license.title: Get started
setup.license.trial_desc: No card needed. Unlimited for 3 days from your first question, then 20 free tasks a day.
setup.password.desc: Protects this app. Everything here can be confidential, so every page asks you to sign in.
setup.password.from_env: The password is already set in this machine's config file.
setup.password.title: Create your password
setup.subtitle: 4 steps, a few minutes. Everything is stored on this machine.
setup.title: First-time setup
setup.vector.desc: Where the documents you check are stored for search.
setup.vector.local_note: Recommended. Uses the Qdrant that comes with the installation. Your documents stay on this machine or your network.
setup.vector.reach_note: The 1n9 central server connects to this database directly, so it must be reachable from the internet or from central's network — an address that only works on this machine is not enough.
setup.vector.skip_note: You can set this later in Settings. Checklists can't be created until a database is set.
setup.vector.title: Document database

tpl.subtitle: Requirement sets you reuse often. Load them when creating a checklist or on its requirements panel.
